name: Matsumae Castle
description: Matsumae Castle, completed 1854, was the northernmost castle of the Edo-period Matsumae domain and the only castle in Hokkaido. The current keep is a 1961 concrete reconstruction (the original burned in 1949); it is famous for its early-spring cherry blossoms.
notes: The keep houses a history museum (¥360 adult). Matsumae Park around the castle has 10,000+ cherry trees. Access: ~3.5h from Hakodate by bus; a day trip is tight — plan an overnight.

ja.name: 松前城
ja.description: 江戸時代に松前藩が築いた北海道唯一の城。現在の天守は1961年の再建で、城内は松前藩の歴史資料館になっています。日本一早い桜の名所としても知られます。
ja.notes: 天守の資料館は大人360円。函館からはバスで約3.5時間と遠く、日帰りはタイトです。
